description: Example data shipped with Event Horizon. It is a fictional party you can duplicate, edit, or delete. Nothing in the plugin depends on this event.

venue.name: The Sample Hall
venue.notes: A made-up room. Leave ward and plot blank when the party is not in a house.

schedule.title: Welcome
schedule.hostNotes: Wait until the room has settled before the first game.

schedule.title: Uno table
schedule.description: The plugin only tracks who won each match. Play the cards in the game.

djs.name: Nova
djs.introText: Nova is opening the room. Give them a warm welcome, then let the set breathe.
djs.transitionText: Thank Nova, and keep the energy up while we move to the first game.
djs.notes: Do not open the stream link from the plugin. Copy it if you need it.

djs.name: Rio
djs.introText: Rio is taking us out. Introduce them, then read the closing.
djs.notes: A short final set under the closing remarks.

games.name: Send or Delete
games.description: Guess whether the featured guest would publish the chirp.
games.rules: Read the chirp. The room guesses SEND or DELETE. Reveal the answer yourself. Award points by hand.

rounds.title: Lake's closet
rounds.explanation: Lake says a dramatic closet confession is exactly the point of a public chirp.

extras.chirp: I don't have a gil problem. I have a very expensive sense of personal style.

rounds.title: Moss in the morning
rounds.explanation: Moss would rather be known for staying up late than for watering flowers at dawn.

extras.chirp: I woke up early, watered every plant in the apartment, and then went back to bed like a responsible menace.

games.name: Two Truths and a Chirp
games.description: Two posts are real. One was invented for the party.
games.rules: Read all three. The room picks the fabricated post. Reveal it yourself.

rounds.title: Lake's three posts
choices: A. Spent the afternoon rearranging the same three chairs.
B. Won a sabong tournament before breakfast and retired undefeated.
C. Named a minion after a soup.
rounds.explanation: B is the invented post. A and C are the ones Lake actually claims.

games.name: Hall trivia
games.rules: Listen for answers, then give one point to the first correct player. Copy a yell when you want the room to see the scores. Nothing is posted for you.

rounds.title: House lights
rounds.prompt: The Sample Hall dims the lamps before which part of the night?
rounds.explanation: This is fictional trivia about the sample event itself.

rounds.title: A secret
rounds.prompt: What did Rowan hide under the welcome table?
rounds.correctAnswer: A spare box of glow sticks
rounds.explanation: Question-and-answer rounds do not need choices.

games.name: Uno table
games.description: Track the bracket. The card game happens at the table, not in the plugin.
games.rules: Open registration, then players send you a tell that says Uno. Generate the bracket when sign-ups are done. Click a name to record that match. Event Horizon does not deal cards, answer the tell, or hand out the prize.

scripts.title: Welcome
scripts.stageDirections: Smile. Let the room quiet down. Do not rush the first joke.
scripts.spokenText: Welcome to the Sample Starlight Social. I am Rowan, and I will be your host. We have music, a few games, and one contest you can play all night. Grab a seat, say hello to someone new, and I will be back when Nova is ready.
scripts.announcement: Welcome to the Sample Starlight Social. Games start after Nova's opening set.

scripts.title: Send or Delete intro
scripts.spokenText: This game is called Send or Delete. I will read a chirp about Lake or Moss. You decide whether they would publish it or bury it. I will reveal the answer after the room has guessed. Shout SEND or DELETE, and I will keep score up here.
scripts.announcement: Send or Delete is starting. Guess SEND or DELETE.

scripts.title: Closing
scripts.spokenText: That is our night. Thank you for playing, thank you Nova and Rio, and thank you for being kind to each other on the way out. The doors are imaginary, but the gratitude is not. Good night.
scripts.announcement: Thank you for coming to the Sample Starlight Social. Good night.

contests.title: Collect the tags
contests.rules: Three words are hidden. They stay hidden until the host reveals each one. A tell with every word counts. Capitalization and word order do not matter.
contests.notes: This contest has no schedule block. Reveal clues from Live Host.

clues.hostNotes: Hide this until the opening set is underway.

prizes.notes: Split it if two people finish together.
Hand the coins over yourself. The plugin does not trade.
Hand the coins over yourself. The plugin does not trade.

notes.title: Room check
notes.body: Confirm the lights, the DJ handoff, and that the prize table is labeled. This sample note can be edited or deleted.

checklists.text: Set the prizes on the side table
Ask Nova and Rio for the names they want spoken
Put water where the host can reach it
